headline: Nifty jumped 2.40% as *FIIs bought, DIIs sold*
subline: Credit names and autos led the charge. Fear still ticked higher.
hero_text: Nifty closed up 2.40% at 24,536.60. The broader tape did not follow.

why.title: Credit names drove the surge
why.desc: Bajaj Finance rose 7.65% as Financial Services gained 3.99%.

why.title: Autos ran the sector board
why.desc: Maruti, M&M and Tata Motors PV each rose over 5%.

why.title: FIIs bought Rs 14,974.68 Cr
why.desc: DIIs sold Rs 10,444.54 Cr into the same rally.

why.title: Fear gauge ticked higher
why.desc: India VIX rose to 15.58 even as the Nifty jumped.

sector_reasons.Auto: Led the board on Maruti, M&M and Tata Motors PV
sector_reasons.Financials: Bajaj Finance and Shriram Finance drove it
sector_reasons.Media: Slipped while the rest of the tape rose
sector_reasons.Energy: ONGC and NTPC held it back

bonus_text: FIIs bought Rs 14,974.68 Cr in cash. DIIs sold Rs 10,444.54 Cr. Foreign money set the direction.
movers_note_gainers: Bajaj Finance led at 7.65%. Shriram Finance, M&M and Maruti each added over 5%.
movers_note_losers: Apollo Hospitals fell most at 2.66%. ONGC, NTPC and Coal India trailed.
watch_text: Nifty OI walls sat at 25,000 on the call side and 23,000 on the put side. US jobs data lands at 23:00 IST tomorrow.
lessons: Credit and cars set the pace. Bajaj Finance and Maruti led a 39 of 50 advance.
Price and fear rose together. A big up day still came with a higher VIX.
FIIs bought cash but stayed net negative in index futures. The two books disagreed.
Pockets stayed red inside a wide advance. Energy and media sat out.
alert_text: US non farm payrolls land at 23:00 IST tomorrow. The forecast is 65K against 29K before.
cta_headline: Lenders and carmakers led. *Save it for Friday*.
cta_sub: Next bell is Friday 6 November, with US jobs data due at 23:00 IST.
next_text: Friday 6 November follows a six session run. US payrolls land at 23:00 IST. Nifty weekly expiry is Monday.
caption_a:
Nifty jumped 2.40% to 24,536.6 and fear still rose. India VIX ended at 15.58.
Financial Services gained 3.99% and Auto 4.14%.
FIIs bought Rs 14,974.68 Cr while DIIs sold Rs 10,444.54 Cr.
Watch: US jobs data at 23:00 IST tomorrow.
